mapper.select: SELECT p.property_id AS propertyId, p.address AS title, CONCAT(p.address, ' 위치의 안심 주거 매물입니다.') AS description, p.building_type AS buildingType, p.room_type AS roomType, p.deposit AS deposit, p.monthly_rent AS monthlyRent, p.area AS area, p.floor AS floor, p.built_year AS builtYear, p.address AS address, p.property_latitude AS latitude, p.property_longitude AS longitude, COALESCE(ps.safety_score, 85) AS safetyScore, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ps.safety_score, 85) >= 80 THEN 'SAFE' WHEN COALESCE(ps.safety_score, 85) >= 60 THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'DANGER' END AS safetyGrade, COALESCE(ps.cctv_count, 15) AS cctvCount, COALESCE(ps.street_lamp_count, 35) AS streetlightCount, COALESCE(ps.has_police_station, TRUE) AS hasPoliceStation, p.is_illegal_building AS isIllegalBuilding, COALESCE(p.deal_count, 1) AS dealCount, CASE WHEN b.bookmark_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isBookmarked FROM properties p LEFT JOIN property_safety ps ON p.property_id = ps.property_id LEFT JOIN bookmarks b ON p.property_id = b.property_id AND b.user_id = #{userId} WHERE p.property_id = #{propertyId} AND p.del_yn = 'N'
SELECT image_url FROM property_images WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} ORDER BY display_order ASC
SELECT tag_type FROM property_tag WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} ORDER BY tag_count DESC
SELECT property_id AS propertyId, address, property_latitude AS latitude, property_longitude AS longitude FROM properties
